documentation.file_docstring:
Analytics plane subscriber for real-time event aggregation.

Subscribes to all AgentMesh events and maintains rolling window
statistics for handshakes/min, violations/min, and average trust scores.
member_docstrings:
AnalyticsPlane: Subscribes to all events and aggregates rolling window statistics.

Args:
    bu
_handle_event: Route events to the appropriate aggregator.
_count_in_window: Count entries within the rolling window, pruning expired entries.
_rate_per_min: Calculate per-minute rate within the rolling window.
_avg_score_in_window: Calculate average trust score within the rolling window.
get_stats: Returns current analytics snapshot across all rolling windows.
